A video from Flexound showing its audio technology built into a car seat.

Fanyu Meng returned to it in his 2024 report on the AES Automotive Audio Conference: Hyundai Mobis’s Live Dynamic sound system places exciters in the headrests using Flexound’s technology. See AES Automotive Audio Conference: audio is the new frontier of car innovation.

Video: Flexound, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
